basic_info.description: Cartier-style for the cost of Coach! Exquisitely remodeled with top-quality materials and designer finishes. This top-floor condo-convertible unit in a 2-unit TIC offers a spacious living room with sunny outlooks and a sleek gas fireplace. The open-concept kitchen features marble countertops and Wolf and Sub-Zero stainless appliances, including a six-burner gas range, built-in fridge, dishwasher, and microwave.  A generous island with pendant lighting anchors the kitchen and dining area. Down a sunlit hallway are 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths, including a luxe primary suite with ample closet space and spa-like en-suite walk-in shower. The second bedroom boasts a walk-in closet and opens to a versatile sunroom/3rd bedroom. Enjoy interior access to the exclusive roof deck through a retractable skylight to capture views of the ocean and tops of the Golden Gate Bridge towers, Galanter & Jones heated furniture, firepit, irrigated planter boxes, and a dedicated gas line hookup for grilling. Additional highlights include European white oak flooring with under-floor radiant heating, sunny skylights, tankless water heater, solar with battery storage, in-unit laundry, and 1-car garage with EV charger.  Just a short 1 block walk to local favorite The Coffee Movement or GG Park. Walk Score: 84
